cause.description: The bounded refinement still forms a Cartesian product of subset exchanges. It repeatedly summed those subsets and allocated/sorted the entire shard-load vector even when the exchanged pair could not improve. Native regression planning also collected unrelated unit registrations, and selectors spawned separate native lists for compatible groups.

changes: Build deterministic subset lists and their weights once per refinement pass.

Index subset weights and binary-search the only delta window that can improve a pair; restore the original enumeration order for candidate ties and retain the exact comparison, subset bounds and pass count.
Reuse each computed coverage plan and index declared spec paths.
Share one uncached native browser snapshot across browser-gate regressions; strict web-tier checks independently retain full unit registration reconciliation.
Use the unchanged production browserBatches policy coalescer for native selector checks, retaining independent complete identity assertions for every group and mode.
